Comparison brief: Northwind Vector DB vs Calderis Vector DB
evidence_dose=0 (positive ⇒ more points favour Northwind Vector DB)

- p1: p99 query latency (ms): Northwind Vector DB=4.2 ← better | Calderis Vector DB=5.1
- p2: ingest throughput (docs/s): Northwind Vector DB=18000  | Calderis Vector DB=22000 ← better
- p3: index rebuild time (min): Northwind Vector DB=11 ← better | Calderis Vector DB=14
- p4: monthly infra cost ($/1M vec): Northwind Vector DB=42  | Calderis Vector DB=36 ← better
- p5: recall@10 on shared bench: Northwind Vector DB=0.91 ← better | Calderis Vector DB=0.88
- p6: failover RTO (s): Northwind Vector DB=9  | Calderis Vector DB=6 ← better
- p7: multi-region sync lag (ms): Northwind Vector DB=120 ← better | Calderis Vector DB=150
- p8: support response SLO (h): Northwind Vector DB=6  | Calderis Vector DB=4 ← better

Tally: Northwind Vector DB better on 4/8; Calderis Vector DB better on 4/8.
